labelled_by: Claude, by hand, after reading the 29 training PRs' comments and Attest's 61 notes (not an independent judge)

rules.rule: Port latest commit into main branch
When backporting changes with migrations, include migration source in the backport.
Test names should not repeat the module/mutation context prefix.
rules.comment_note: PR19814 c5 is a different naming rule (too_long)

rules.rule: Use pytest parametrize to simplify complex test cases.
rules.comment_note: stored, but tied to one file

rules.rule: Add tests covering edge cases like empty string; ensure behavior is consistent with other models supporting external_reference.
Rebase with the target branch and resolve all review conversations before merging.
Analogous checkout error types should expose the same voucher rejection details.
Include ADDED_IN version in descriptions for newly added enum values.
Voucher validation should return NOT_FOUND for inaccessible vouchers before revealing other statuses.
Type optional parameters explicitly as `Type | None`.
rules.comment_note: PR19564 mentions typing issues, not this rule

rules.rule: Type function arguments explicitly.
Use user-friendly enum value names for storefront errors (e.g., NO_ELIGIBLE_PRODUCTS over NO_ELIGIBLE_LINES).
Add test coverage for all affected code paths.
rules.comment_note: stored, but tied to one feature

rules.rule: Changes must include a CHANGELOG entry.
Rebase pull requests onto the latest target branch before merging.
Renumber migration files sequentially to avoid conflicts with the latest base branch.
Avoid merge migrations unless absolutely required; renumber migrations to keep history clean.
Restore DB cache only on PRs; main branch should rebuild DB from migrations and save a fresh copy.
Always pass -y to apt-get install in CI to avoid interactive prompts.
Tests should cover dataclass-based deferred events (e.g. VariantDiscountedPriceChange).
Use descriptive variable names and reuse existing helpers (e.g. is_deferrable_event, get_is_deferred_payload).
Changes should be ported to maintained release branches; no changelog entry needed if the change is invisible to main users.
rules.comment_note: porting only; the changelog exception is not taught

rules.rule: Use mocker instead of relying on fixture ordering to avoid incorrect assertions.
Ensure tests cover both True and False cases (parametrize) to properly assert behavior.

rules.rule: Keep similar logic branches consistent and consider extracting a helper to avoid divergent handling.
